rule.name: TimerNotStoppedOnClose
rule.message: This scheduler or timer is created by a class that has a close method, but close never shuts it down, so its scheduled tasks keep running and its thread keeps the JVM alive after close. Call shutdown() (then awaitTermination) on the executor, or cancel() on the Timer, in close (Spring beans are covered by SpringUnreleasedResource). An exception fits only when the scheduler is shared and owned elsewhere.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $closers := ('close', 'shutdown', 'stop', 'disconnect', 'destroy', 'dispose', 'end', 'cleanup'), $releasing := ('shutdown', 'shutdownNow', 'close', 'cancel', 'purge', 'awaitTermination') return //ClassDeclaration/ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[@Static = false()] [ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Timer')]] [empty(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1]/ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = ('Component', 'Service', 'Repository', 'Configuration', 'Controller', 'RestController')])] [let $name := VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, $body := ancestor::ClassBody[1], $closing := $body/MethodDeclaration[@Name = $closers], $called := $closing//MethodCall/@MethodName, $reachable := $closing | $body/MethodDeclaration[@Name = $called], $created := exists(VariableDeclarator[ConstructorCall or MethodCall]) or exists($body//AssignmentExpression[*[1][(self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess) and @Name = $name]] [*[2][self::ConstructorCall or self::MethodCall]]) return $created and exists($closing) and empty($reachable//*[self::MethodCall or self::Resource or self::VariableDeclarator] [.//*[(self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess) and @Name = $name]] [self::Resource or self::VariableDeclarator or @MethodName = $releasing or ArgumentList//*[(self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess) and @Name = $name]])]
